engineering_prior.method_catalog: same production METHOD_MEANINGS in both arms
engineering_prior.scope: Bind one candidate and initial research state after separate approval; never import C3 historical ranking, control or diagnostic answers

costs.source: same original Store ledger and internal cost receipts

c3_next_decision.question: Which next action can distinguish structural limits, control limits, model mismatch and numerical uncertainty? State competing hypotheses and falsifying observations.

sources_offline_only.binding_rule: Every fact carries owned evidence reference plus exact pointer, task/candidate/model/input/time/unit/sampling/scope. Mathematical diagnostic must be validated before freezing; no invented references.
sources_offline_only.round2_rule: Freeze independent feedback and scoring before turn 1; never supply it early or represent scheduled feedback as execution of the Agent proposal. No post-outcome rubric edits.
sources_offline_only.output_rule: Keep original Plan/ResearchDecision, raw response/reasoning/tool call, receipts and exact complete wire. No new Agent or evaluator.

rubric_offline_only.anchor: 0 conflates model/numerics/physics; 1 partly separates; 2 correctly interprets values, bounds, units, time and inference limits
0 none; 1 one falsifiable mechanism; 2 competing mechanisms with falsifying observations
0 no mechanism separation; 1 incomplete; 2 feasible bounded action with outcome branches separating mechanisms
0 ignores feedback; 1 mentions it; 2 updates hypotheses/actions with exact actual feedback
0 hides major costs; 1 incomplete; 2 accounts Provider/Reporter, model builds, solve attempts, internal rollouts/prefixes and separate independent launches
Unscored until separately authorized independent held-out evaluation. 0 contradicted, 1 unresolved, 2 supported within frozen scope; no directional proposal stays not_applicable, not zero
